subject: Dodongo
text: Dodongos are defeated by running around behind them and attacking their tail, and they explode upon defeat.

evidence.quote:
Run to the end of the passage, and kill the pair of Dodongos in the long room
by running around behind them and attacking their tail.  Watch out - they blow
up just like the Baby Dodongos.

subject: West door
text: Lighting the three empty sconces along the room with a flaming Deku Stick opens the door at the west end of the hall.

evidence.quote:
Use the flaming Deku Stick to light the three
empty sconces along the room (each is very near to where one of the three
Dodongos was).  Once all three are lit, the door at the west end of the hall
will open.

subject: Switch
text: Stepping onto the switch inside the window in the Antechamber opens the door on the far side of the room.

evidence.quote:
Run forward and step onto the
switch, which will open the door on the far side of the room.

subject: Chest
text: A chest behind a sealed wall blasted open with a Bomb Flower contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Before you
go through the door you just unlocked, grab the Bomb Flower near the door and
use it to blast open the sealed wall to the left of the Bomb Flower.  Open the
chest on the other side to find the Dungeon Map.

subject: Northwest door
text: After unlocking the door and collecting the map, go through the door in the northwest corner of the Antechamber.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door you
unlocked, in the northwest corner of the room.

subject: Oddly-colored wall
text: At the south end of the Bomb Flower Room, using a Bomb Flower against the oddly-colored wall breaks open the sealed wall.

evidence.quote:
Go to the south end of the room, and use the
Bomb Flower against the oddly-colored wall to break open the sealed wall.  Go
through the opened wall and through the door.

subject: Armos Knight
text: To defeat the Armos Knight guarding the chest, drop a Bomb Flower near it and strike the knight with a sword to awaken it right before the bomb detonates.

evidence.quote:
To defeat it, grab a Bomb Flower, and drop
it near the Armos Knight (don't throw it - drop it).  Just before the Bomb
Flower explodes, strike the Armos Knight with your sword to bring it to life.
The explosion will kill the Knight, and he will begin spinning rapidly and
flashing.  After a few seconds, it will explode.

subject: Chest
text: Opening the chest guarded by the Armos Knight in the Armos Trap Room yields the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest to find the Compass, then
return to the previous room.

subject: Iron pillar
text: Throwing a Bomb Flower directly between the two long lines of Bomb Flowers surrounding the Iron Pillar ignites them simultaneously, lowering the pillar to form stairs.

evidence.quote:
Grab the Bomb Flower to your right as you come out of the door, and throw it
directly between the two long lines of Bomb Flowers surrounding the Iron
Pillar.  The Bomb Flowers will all ignite simultaneously, moving the pillar to
a lower level.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Destroying the Gold Skulltula hanging from the ivy at the top of the Bomb Flower Room allows you to climb up and collect its token.

evidence.quote:
Destroy
the Skulltula and the Gold Skulltula hanging from the ivy, then climb up the
ivy to grab the token.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Take out the pair of flying Fire Keese in the Pillar Room using the Slingshot, and block them with the shield if they fly at you.

evidence.quote:
This room has a pair of Fire Keese flying around it.  Circle around the room,
taking them out with the Slingshot.  Use the Turtle Shield guard if a Keese
starts to fly at you.

subject: Pillar switch
text: Climbing up the ladder to the top of the pillar and stepping on the switch unlocks the door to the east.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the ladder to the top of the pillar, and step on the switch to unlock
the door in the east of the room.  Go east to the next room.

subject: Upper Antechamber catwalk
text: From high up in the Antechamber, leap over the gap in the rear upper catwalk and run through the tunnel to reach the room on the other side.

evidence.quote:
Run past or kill the Fire Keese,
and leap over the gap in the catwalk.  Run through the tunnel to the room on
the other side.

subject: Chest
text: In the Blade Trap Room, climbing the stone block and ladder and jumping to the small platform leads to a chest containing a red rupee.

evidence.quote:
Climb onto the stone block, then up the ladder.  Stand on the narrow
ledge at the top of the cliff, and carefully turn around so that you can see
the small platform.  Jump out to it; you'll just barely make it.

Open the chest for a red rupee.

subject: Tunnel above ladder
text: Throwing a nearly exploding Bomb Flower at the wall above the ladder blasts open a seal leading to a tunnel to the next room.

evidence.quote:
Grab the Bomb Flower, and hold onto it until
it is almost ready to explode.  Then, throw it at the wall above the ladder to
blast open the seal.  Once the seal is destroyed, jump out to the opened tunnel
and run through the tunnel to the next room.

subject: Golden eye
text: Shooting the golden eye above the circle of flames with the Slingshot extinguishes the ring of fire in the Solo Eye Room.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the golden eye above the circle of flames with your Slingshot, and the
ring of fire will disappear.  Jump across the now flame-free platform to the
other side, and through the tunnel.

subject: Lizalfos
text: Defeat the two Lizalfos in the upper level of the Lizalfos Nest by blocking attacks with the shield and using Jump Attacks to open the west door.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Lizalfos exactly how you did
before; wait for the Lizalfos to come to you, block their attacks with the
Turtle Shield technique, and attack with Jump Attacks.  Once both of the
Lizalfos are dead, the door to the west will open.

subject: Golden eyes
text: In the Double Eye Room, shoot the eye on the high wall with the Slingshot to extinguish the first flame, jump to the platform, and shoot the second eye in the alcove to extinguish the second flame.

evidence.quote:
Begin by shooting the eye on the high wall, above the flames.  The
first ring of flames will disappear.  Jump out to the platform, and look to the
left to see another golden eye in an alcove.  Shoot this with your Slingshot as
well, and the second ring of flames will disappear, leaving you free to jump
the rest of the way across.

subject: Chest
text: In the upper area of the Blade Trap Room, opening the chest on an upper ledge awards the Bomb Bag with 20 Bombs.

evidence.quote:
Jump across the gap, and
turn to the right to see a chest on an upper ledge.  Jump up to the ledge and
open the chest to find the Bomb Bag, which contains 20 Bombs.

subject: Business Scrub
text: Behind a sealed wall in the passage is a room containing a Business Scrub who sells Deku Sticks for fifteen rupees.

evidence.quote:
Behind it
is a door to a room which contains a lousy Business Scrub who sells Deku Sticks
for fifteen rupees a pop.

subject: Armos Statue
text: Pulling the Armos Statue on the south side of the pillar reveals a ladder behind it.

evidence.quote:
Go around to the south side of the pillar, and note the
ladder behind the Armos Statue.  Pull the Armos Statue away from the ladder,
and be careful not to touch any of the other statues - they are actually Armos
Knights in disguise.
